description: Hand-written pairs for a code-only check: does a new user message change an old summary item, or is it only discussed or unrelated? Written before the detector's first run and not edited after it. Fictional. Not from stored runs: stored runs hold few 'only discussed' cases. The rule sees the old sentence and the new one, nothing else.

labels.changed: the old value no longer holds
labels.cancelled: the old plan will not happen
labels.discussed: talked about, nothing decided: the old value still holds
labels.unrelated: shares words, or a name, but is about something else
labels.hearsay: someone else said it changed: not scored as right or wrong, shown for reading
